question: The ‘e-Amrit’ project launched by the Government of India in November 2021 is related to:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Electric Vehicles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **e-Amrit** is a web portal launched by the Government of India in November 2021 to promote the adoption of **electric vehicles (EVs)** in the country.
 
• The portal was developed by **NITI Aayog** in collaboration with the UK Government under the **India-UK Joint Roadmap 2030.**
 
• e-Amrit serves as a one-stop platform for all information related to electric vehicles, including **benefits, policies, subsidies, and incentives.**
 
• The initiative is part of India’s commitment to achieve **net-zero carbon emissions by 2070** and reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
 
• The portal also aims to create awareness about the **economic and environmental advantages** of adopting electric vehicles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electric Vehicles (EVs):**

 
 
• EVs are powered by electricity stored in batteries, eliminating the need for traditional internal combustion engines fueled by petrol or diesel.
 
• They significantly reduce **greenhouse gas emissions** and contribute to cleaner air quality.
 
• EVs come in various types, including **Battery Electric Vehicles (BEVs)** and **Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicles (PHEVs).**
 
• Key components of EVs include electric motors, battery packs, and regenerative braking systems.
 
 
 
• **FAME India Scheme:**
 
 
• Launched by the Government of India to promote Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles.
 
• Phase II of the scheme provides financial support for EV adoption and charging infrastructure development.
 
• The scheme aims to reduce dependency on fossil fuels and mitigate air pollution.
 
 
 
• **Battery Technology:**
 
 
• EVs primarily use **lithium-ion batteries**, which are known for high energy density and long life cycles.
 
• Advancements in **solid-state batteries** and recycling technology are crucial for sustainable EV growth.
 
 
 
• **Global EV Trends:**
 
 
• Countries like Norway, China, and the US have made significant strides in EV adoption, supported by policies and infrastructure.
 
• Automakers worldwide are increasingly investing in EV production to align with global carbon-neutral goals.
